title: documentation: Missing some widget icons
body:
Some widgets do not have a specific icon in the documentation, they are re-using other icons. Here is the list of icons to add:
- [ ] hitsPerPageSelector
- [ ] hierarchicalMenu
- [ ] numericRefinementList
- [ ] priceRanges

I also do not understand the `hits` icon. This looks like a graph to me.
![image](https://cloud.githubusercontent.com/assets/283419/11030263/42d729a4-86cd-11e5-9f22-973edd35b4a0.png).

cc @Shipow

comments.body:
Oh ok, but the fact that it limits the number of results to 3 does not convey the way I usually picture a list of records returned.

I like the hierarchical one, but I'm not sure which is which for the others

I'd say:
- `hierarchicalMenu`
- `numericRefinementList`
- `priceRanges`
- `hitsPerPageSelector`: this is the only one that doesn't fully convince me.
- `clearAll`
Oh ok, yeah, with the name alongside this will be understandable.
